about.text: Made with cow's milk, from 3 to 4 kg in weight. It has a firm consistency and texture, with some spherical eyes and a smooth but defined flavor. Used as cut cheese.

sources.text: eyed cut cheese, 3-4 kg; the Wikipedia 'Zapicán' page is the village, not the cheese
